# The Long Marsh

## Overview

Flat water for two days in every direction, and the reason the survey contract pays what
it does.

## Geography

Poles find no bottom past the second night. What charts exist disagree with each other.

## Survey Run (Session 3)

Cost the crew a lantern. The route the Company wanted surveyed is not the route the crew
took.

## Deeper Water (Session 4)

Opened out entirely, and [[Cinder Steps]] was standing in it.

## Dangers

- Losing the light
- Losing the bottom

## Connections

- [[Cinder Steps]]
- [[The Long Marsh|the marsh]] as the charts name it, versus [[Halvern Reach]] as the Company does
- [[The Ambergris Company]]

## Notes

Two sessions in and nobody has drawn a chart the crew trusts.
